guide_section: LAB-04 -- Calendar baseline va robust-neighborhood selection

tasks.requirement: fixed parameter matrix traced before the search
tasks.note: optuna_trials defaults to 0 and mode 'none' ran ONE trial: the fixed matrix is the default

tasks.requirement: current selected mode traced
tasks.note: mode 'none', 1 trial, no search

tasks.requirement: optuna sampler identified
tasks.note: TPESampler(seed=study_seed) + DuplicatePruner

tasks.requirement: proxy vs native objective resolved
tasks.note: endpoint backend returned all-zero Sharpes for this strategy shape; proxy used, divergence recorded

tasks.requirement: candidate freeze traced
tasks.note: _select_is_candidate_records then _select_oos_candidate_record, before outer evaluation

tasks.requirement: OOS usage measured, not assumed
tasks.note: mutation probe with an IS-invariance precondition; per_fold_decay moves the selection

tasks.requirement: baseline floor traced
tasks.note: min_trades_per_year and trade_penalty_factor both default to None: no floor unless configured

tasks.requirement: retention traced
tasks.note: financial=score, research=none, scope=selected_final_execution

tasks.requirement: modes 1-5 of the PINNED version distinguished
tasks.note: all six settings run; mode_5 collapses to one fold and is full-sample calibration

tasks.requirement: no assumption that every mode calls the generic selector
tasks.note: two families measured separately; the WFO record selectors are not CandidateSelector

tasks.requirement: sharp peak vs broad plateau
bad neighbors retained
tasks.note: a losing valid neighbour raises F and lowers R and P_survive; measured both ways

tasks.requirement: duplicate samples
tasks.note: probe ids unique inside a tight radius

tasks.requirement: fixed dimensions
tasks.note: DEFECT_CONFIRMED on candidate_selection

tasks.requirement: sampled-span scaling
tasks.note: DEFECT_CONFIRMED, 98x collapse measured

tasks.requirement: missing consensus
tasks.note: INSUFFICIENT_LOCAL_EVIDENCE, no fabricated plateau

tasks.requirement: invalid centroid
tasks.note: T33, deployment refused

tasks.requirement: raw baseline override
tasks.note: T35, guard disagreement logged

tasks.requirement: actual source symbols and reproducers attached
tasks.note: _param_distance / _numeric_span with file:line, each with a runnable reproducer

tasks.requirement: already-correct behaviour recorded as verified-existing
tasks.note: the WFO family is VERIFIED_EXISTING_CORRECT; only the CandidateSelector family is accused

tasks.requirement: geometry from a per-alpha schema
tasks.note: four schemas

tasks.requirement: dependent params ordered by construction
tasks.note: no post-hoc repair

tasks.requirement: inactive flags excluded from distance
tasks.note: 0 distance when the branch is off

tasks.requirement: seed and design frozen and reproducible
tasks.note: identical probe ids under three PYTHONHASHSEED values

tasks.requirement: every valid bad probe kept in the denominator
tasks.note: measured

tasks.requirement: runtime error means incomplete evidence
tasks.note: INCOMPLETE_PANEL

tasks.requirement: anchors come from TPE, the incumbent AND space-filling coverage (7.2 step 1)
tasks.note: 4 anchor slots: 2 TPE + 1 farthest-point + 1 incumbent, total budget still 96

tasks.requirement: probe radius is a registered sensitivity, not tuned after an outer result
tasks.note: radii 0.06/0.12/0.24 declared before the run; the primary stays 0.12 regardless

tasks.requirement: structurally invalid is not bad performance
tasks.note: excluded, not penalised

tasks.requirement: score follows guide 7.3
tasks.note: G=Q0.25, F=median_e Q0.75 regret, R=G-lambda_F*F, P_survive

tasks.requirement: same episode lengths, risk and cost
tasks.note: equal-length episodes; one frozen account contract for every candidate and arm

tasks.requirement: incumbent gets the same validation budget
tasks.note: same episodes and neighbours

tasks.requirement: before/after guard logged
tasks.note: both recorded

tasks.requirement: centroid/medoid only over feasible evaluated candidates with traceable panels
tasks.note: medoid over ELIGIBLE only; centroid is a proposal until evaluated

tasks.requirement: same calendar, training memory, engine, retention and eval budget
tasks.note: seven matched conditions listed

tasks.requirement: no regime information in either arm
tasks.note: neither arm reads a feature panel

tasks.requirement: pilot one cell then expand to all 20
tasks.note: A-SC/BTCUSDT first, then the full 4x5 matrix

tasks.requirement: no claiming full scope from the winning symbol
tasks.note: every cell status reported, winners and losers

tasks.requirement: selection frozen before outer evaluation (guide 7.2 step 7)
tasks.note: the test window is mutated and both arms' selections stay byte-identical

tasks.requirement: the fast evaluator equals a whole-window fixed point
tasks.note: identical fills, reasons and equity against the slow reference loop

tasks.requirement: entries are sized to the frozen entry notional
tasks.note: 2000 USDT per entry, not one whole unit; this is what LAB-03's zero-fill smoke missed

tasks.requirement: actual local coverage reported
lower tail reported
survival reported
trade counts reported
period concentration reported
parameter-behaviour fingerprint reported
tasks.note: turnover, distinct sets, trades

tasks.requirement: A and B both kept for the factorial regardless of the result
no dead code, unused imports or undefined names in lab source
tasks.note: pyflakes gate; raw-supplied/ is excluded because its lint IS the evidence (SD-HASH-01)

tasks.requirement: the four supplied alphas remain byte-identical
tasks.note: the lint exclusion is only safe while the originals are untouched

tasks.requirement: dev tooling declared and kept out of the runtime lock
tasks.note: pyflakes/autoflake added after the LAB-01 pin; engine pin 1.1.1/0.4.2 unchanged

tasks.requirement: one source of truth for blocked alphas and decision intervals
tasks.note: NOT_READY reads the LAB-02 certification; DECISION_INTERVAL is the LAB-03 object itself

tasks.requirement: centroid geometry matches the distance that selected it
tasks.note: log kinds use the geometric mean; ints snap to the declared grid

tasks.requirement: centroid of an ordered pair cannot collapse into an infeasible point
no selector output depends on PYTHONHASHSEED
tasks.note: probe design and centroid tie-break both checked under three salts

tasks.requirement: trade counts distinguish engine fills from entries
a partial matrix is labelled partial and blocks the L04.5/L04.6 rows
retention reasons name the constraint that actually bound
tasks.note: ALL_FAIL_ECONOMIC_QUALITY vs NO_LOCAL_PANEL vs ALL_FAIL_SURVIVAL, not one status for all

tasks.requirement: the B-A contrast states its confound before it is read
tasks.note: asymmetric switching rate; the HOLD control that would separate it is named and not run

tasks.requirement: the committed code still reproduces a committed cutoff decision
tasks.note: a multi-hour run executes the modules loaded at launch; this re-runs one real cutoff

tasks.requirement: confirmed engine defects recorded as a bounded proposal, never applied
tasks.note: CLAUDE.md rule 1; a test proves the installed wheel still has the original body

tasks.requirement: which selector the public route actually uses is known
tasks.note: _select_oos_candidate_record under metric robust_decay = argmax objective

tasks.requirement: honest A/B result and search budget reported
tasks.note: unique executions and candidate-episode visits, not a trial count

tasks.requirement: legacy OOS-selected modes labelled, never reused as an untouched claim
